thread:
customer_jane: Hey - we started getting JSON parse errors in prod after switching to streaming JSON mode. Parser fails with 'Unexpected end of input'. Happening ~2-3% of requests. example request_id: r-ff12c9a3

customer_jane: We only see this in streaming responses that we pipe directly into our validator. Non-streamed responses are fine.

lina_support: Thanks, Jane — sorry about that. Can you paste the last few bytes you received for one failing request? Any client logs (curl/timeout/socket closed) would help.

customer_jane: Pasting the raw frames we captured (we log each SSE chunk):

```
data: {"id": "r-ff12c9a3", "choices":[{"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"{\"order_id\":123,\"items\":[{\"sku\":\"X1\",\"q\":2}],\"total\": 49}"},"index":0}]}

data: {"id":"r-ff12c9a3","choices":[{"delta":{"content":".99}\n"},"index":0}]}

// then connection closed by remote (client saw EOF)
```

customer_jane: The final closing `}]}` is missing. Our JSON parser chokes. We see the socket FIN immediately after that second chunk.

emily_support: Do you see any `data: [DONE]` frame or empty chunk?

customer_jane: No, nothing. Just EOF. No explicit done frame.

lina_support: Thanks — assigning to eng-runtime to investigate chunk termination. Can you share the full request payload (redact keys) and whether you set max_tokens or stop sequences?

customer_jane: Payload: `{
  "model":"redwood-xl-1B",
  "mode":"structured",
  "stream":true,
  "json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"integer"},"items":{"type":"array"}}},
  "max_tokens": 256
}`

michael_ops: I can repro in staging with a similar set-up using `curl -N` and piping to jq strict parser; occasionally the stream ends mid-object if the backend issues an early connection close. Repro rate low but deterministic under load.

eng_runtime: Looking at logs for r-ff12c9a3 — backend model signalled finish, but the serving layer emitted last token(s) in a small chunk then closed the connection before emitting the final `data: [DONE]` sentinel. Investigating whether the chunk flush code path can return early on connection race.

ops-ryan: Any correlation with keepalive or proxy timeouts? Could an intermediate LB drop before we flush trailing bytes?

eng_runtime: Good call. I see an upstream FIN from the client after 120s idle then we close. But some requests show FIN immediately after last token; likely the agent sends final packet but doesn't flush the SSE terminator due to buffering. Appears to be a race on close + TLS record flush on our side.

lina_support: Short-term mitigation for customers: 1) Use tolerant parser that buffers until either `data: [DONE]` or a short idle timeout (e.g., 200ms) after which you attempt to re-request the final chunk using non-stream mode for that request_id; 2) Toggle `stream:false` for critical endpoints until we patch.

emily_support: Can you try setting `Connection: keep-alive` explicitly and bump client socket read timeout to 30s as a test?

customer_jane: We'll try the timeout bump and report. If we reproduce, should we provide packet capture?

eng_runtime: Yes please — pcap (TLS) or server-side trace is ideal. For now we added a safe guard: ensure the SSE `data: [DONE]` is flushed in a final write before connection close. We'll run a canary roll in the next hour.

michael_ops: Created internal ticket INF-4721, tagging eng-runtime. Marking P2 since parsing failures cause consumer crashes.

customer_jane: Thanks — appreciate the quick response. We'll test the keep-alive/timeout changes and post results.

eng_runtime: Follow-up: if you can reproduce reliably, include `request_id` and local client logs showing the exact byte counts. Also, temporarily you can post-process partial JSON by appending `}]}` when validator fails and compare with non-streamed response to confirm it's only truncation, not schema drift.

emily_support: We'll update you once the canary exits. Sorry for the disruption :pray:
